title: Singularity-Bench: Can Agents Build Agents?
abstract: arXiv:2611.16591v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Frontier AI agents increasingly succeed on realistic, long-horizon tasks and are beginning to improve the systems through which they operate. Yet existing benchmarks often restrict agents to narrow action spaces, use simplified environments, or rely on verification methods that are unreliable for evaluating arbitrary agent-generated systems. We introduce Singularity-Bench, an open-ended benchmark for autonomous AI development with six end-to-end tasks spanning pre-training, mid-training, post-training, inference, the agent harness, and cluster orchestration. Each task requires agents to implement core systems from a minimal starting point and evaluates them against mature human-engineered baselines on identical hardware. Additionally, through extensive red-teaming covering 9 of the 10 categories in the OWASP Top 10 for Agentic Applications, we expose reward-hacking vulnerabilities in the conventional Harbor framework and develop Breakwat

translated_title: Singularity-Bench：智能体能构建智能体吗？
translated_abstract: 前沿AI智能体在现实的、长时程任务上正取得越来越多的成功，并且开始改进它们自身赖以运行的系统。然而，现有基准通常将智能体限制在狭窄的动作空间中，使用简化的环境，或依赖对评估任意智能体生成系统并不可靠的验证方法。我们提出了Singularity-Bench，一个面向自主AI开发的开放式基准，包含六项端到端任务，涵盖预训练、中期训练、后训练、推理、智能体框架以及集群编排。每项任务都要求智能体从一个极简起点实现核心系统，并在相同硬件条件下将其与成熟的人工工程基线进行评估比较。此外，通过覆盖OWASP智能体应用十大风险中10类中的9类的大规模红队测试，我们揭示了传统Harbor框架中的奖励破解漏洞，并开发了Breakwat（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了开放式基准Singularity-Bench，通过六项覆盖AI开发全流程（从预训练到集群编排）的端到端任务，评估智能体能否从零实现核心AI系统并与人工工程基线对比，同时通过红队测试发现并修复了现有评估框架中的奖励破解漏洞。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces Singularity-Bench, an open-ended benchmark with six end-to-end tasks spanning the full AI development stack—from pre-training to cluster orchestration—to evaluate whether agents can build core AI systems from scratch against human-engineered baselines, while extensive red-teaming exposes and addresses reward-hacking vulnerabilities in existing evaluation frameworks.
